$comment: Operator-owned ride listings (operator marketplace track). Separate from listing-contract.json (managed listings under the house account). Field keys are permanent once listings use them.

approved: listing type id operator-ride-rental, authored by the operator's (company) account
ride class stored as a listing field (rideClass), not in the shared Console category tree
public fields: rideClass, manufacturer and rideModel (only when printed on the operator's site, high confidence), minRiderHeightIn, riderRules, homeState, serviceStates
dimensions public only when taken from the operator's own website (footprintSource operator_website); type-typical and model-typical values kept private, never on the listing

2026-10-05 founder go: one photo per listing from the operator's own website, provenance recorded (privateData.photoSource, metadata.photoSource=operator_website), removed on request via npm run import:photos -- --remove <companyId>
2026-10-05 founder go: approve (publish) the imported listings in the Test marketplace; Live publishing needs a separate go
notApproved: transaction process for operator listings (no transactionProcessAlias/unitType set; listings cannot be transacted)
public use of operator-written descriptions before claim (copied from operator sites; listings stay unpublished)

listingType.label: Operator ride rental
listingType.author: operator company account (imported, unclaimed until claimed)

publicFields.rule: only when mfrConfidence is high (as printed on the operator's site)
lowercase state code, same codes as requestableStates

geolocation: company HQ rounded to 1 decimal place (~11 km): listing locations are public and some HQ coordinates are street-precise
privateData: footprintTypical (range or model-typical L/W/H, not shown)
neverInListingData: street addresses or exact HQ coordinates

photos.note: Copyright belongs to the photographer regardless of subject; the founder accepted the risk with removal on request.

bookability.rule: true only when the operator's Sharetribe account has finished Stripe Connect onboarding; set by the transactional side (never by the search site). Search shows 'Book this ride' (Sharetribe listing page) when true, otherwise 'Request this ride' (our request flow). Absent = not bookable.
